name: Ajay Girolkar
tagline: 11 years of Swift. Most of it inside global banks and financial firms, where a crash, a leak or a rejected build was never an option.
location: Pune, India · works US & EU hours
disclosure: Self-initiated demo build. Designed and coded end to end by me to show current iOS 26 / SwiftUI standards — not client work, and no client material appears in it.
proof_title: What a build like this gets you
proof: Production SwiftUI screens, not clickable prototypes — code your team can ship
MVVM + Clean Architecture with a design token layer: colors, type, spacing, radii
async/await networking, actors and structured concurrency. No third-party UI deps
Light and dark, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels and reduced-motion paths from day one
Xcode project that builds clean on first open, plus a Loom walkthrough of the code
TestFlight and App Store submission handled, including privacy manifests and review notes

services.name: Screen build
services.body: 3 SwiftUI screens from your designs, with the token layer and mock data.

services.name: Feature or MVP
services.body: 6+ screens, MVVM, navigation stack, async/await API layer, light and dark.

services.name: Full app or rescue
services.body: End to end build, or an audit and rescue of an inherited codebase, to App Store.

also: UIKit / Objective-C → SwiftUI migration, Swift 6 strict concurrency
On-device AI with Apple Foundation Models, Core ML, Vision
Claude and OpenAI integrations with streaming, cost control and privacy
StoreKit 2 subscriptions, Widgets, Live Activities, App Intents and Siri
Crash, performance and App Store rejection fixes on an existing app
XCTest, Fastlane, Xcode Cloud and GitHub Actions CI/CD
cta_title: Send me the app you are trying to build
cta_body: Tell me what you are working on and I will tell you straight whether I am the right fit, what it takes and what it costs. Reply the same day, most days.

process.title: Requirements
process.body: You send designs or a reference app, target iOS version and API docs. The clock starts here, not the day we agree to work together.

process.title: Foundation
process.body: Design tokens, navigation shell and data models land. You get a build you can run on your own device.

process.title: Screens
process.body: Feature screens built against real or mock data, pushed to your repo daily. No silent weeks.

process.title: Ship
process.body: Code walkthrough on Loom, one revision round, and a checklist for App Store submission.

transfer_title: What this transfers to your build
transfer_fallback: Same engine underneath: SwiftUI screens on a design token layer, MVVM boundaries a second developer can read, and state for empty, loading, error and success handled before the happy path is called done.

gate.transfer: If your app is themed by content — events, brands, teams, listings — this is the pattern: colour derived in code from the artwork, contrast solved rather than eyeballed, and a checkout that shows fees before the total. The palette extractor and the PassKit wallet flow drop into any ticketing, booking or membership app.

wealthkit.transfer: Money screens are unforgiving: precise numbers, live states and no room for a rounding error. Server-driven layout, SwiftUI Charts, Keychain and biometrics here are the same pieces a banking, investing, lending or wallet app needs — built by someone who has shipped them inside regulated financial firms for 11 years.

fitnesspro.transfer: Built for a phone read one-handed, mid-activity, with sweat on the screen: large hit targets, glanceable numbers, and live session state that survives backgrounding. Directly applicable to fitness, field-service, logistics or any app used while the user is doing something else.

shopease.transfer: An editorial commerce front end that keeps the product photography intact: image-forward cells, a bag with real empty and error states, and a checkout that does not lose the customer. Reusable for any retail, marketplace or D2C app where the catalogue is the brand.

socialflow.transfer: A media feed that stays smooth at scale — prefetching, cell reuse, edge-to-edge video and image handling, plus compose and profile flows. The base for any social, community, creator or in-app feed feature.

nativeaistudio.transfer: A production pattern for putting an LLM inside an iOS app: AsyncSequence token streaming, cancellation, cost control, on-device history in SwiftData and keys held in Keychain. This is what an AI feature in your existing app actually looks like.

nocturne.transfer: Audio, timers and background sessions done properly — playback that survives lock, a wind-down flow that respects reduced motion, and a dark palette engineered for a bedroom at 3am. Applies to any audio, meditation, sleep or long-session app.

lingo.transfer: A learning loop with real depth: progression state, spaced review, mistake handling and reward moments that motivate without the streak-shaming. The template for education, training, onboarding or any app that has to teach something.

wayfare.transfer: Map-first UI with a three-detent sheet, live departures and disruption states — the hard parts of any location app. Reusable for transit, delivery, field ops, travel or store-locator features.

cta_body_platform: Message me with what you are working on — the screens, the deadline, and where it is stuck. I will tell you straight whether I am the right fit, what it takes and how long it runs. Reply the same day, most days.
